deprecation_stages.name: LOCK_OR_PREVIEW_UI
actions: replace /servers route content with SafeFeatureCard locked-preview equivalent OR
hide /servers from menu until SLC-H live
keep route file (no delete), only modify UI

deprecation_stages.name: READ_ONLY_PREVIEW_SAFE
actions: introduce server_profile_preview screen behind safe-previews hub

deprecation_stages.name: DUAL_ROUTE_COMPATIBILITY_LAYER
actions: add dual-write logic: legacy POST also writes server_profiles, new POST writes users.server
validator ensures dual-write is idempotent + reversible
deprecation_stages.flag_flips: add new flag (default OFF); do not flip

deprecation_stages.name: SEED_AND_BACKFILL_SERVER_PROFILES
actions: create rollback runbook with byte-identical inverse

deprecation_stages.name: UI_CUTOVER_BEHIND_FLAG
actions: switch /servers UI to call new endpoint behind SERVER_PROFILES_UI_CUTOVER flag
legacy endpoints still receive writes via dual-write

deprecation_stages.name: DEPRECATE_LEGACY_HEADERS
actions: add HTTP Sunset/Deprecation headers to GET /api/servers and POST /api/server/select
emit 410 Gone for non-allow-listed clients after grace period (TBD)

deprecation_stages.name: REMOVE_LEGACY_AFTER_GRACE
actions: finalize users.server deprecation in user model

divergence_from_existing_120D: This pack expands 4 → 8 stages to add explicit LOCK_OR_PREVIEW (stage 2) and READ_ONLY_PREVIEW_SAFE (stage 3) between audit and dual-write. Existing 120D plan begins at dual-write directly.
risk_reason: Plan is paper-only. Risk is in execution drift and sequencing failures across packs; each stage requires its own approval marker.
